notes:
Text files from another program can now come into ChatsRecall by themselves.

## Highlights

- :folder: **Watched folders** Point ChatsRecall at a folder once, and every new or changed .txt or .md file in it becomes a searchable conversation within a few seconds. Find it in Settings, under Watched folders.

> Watched folders, Fireflies sync fixes, security fixes

## Added

- Settings has a new Watched folders section. Paste a folder's full path, give it a name, and press Watch this folder. Each file becomes one conversation, titled from its file name, and the folder's name shows as a project on the Projects page and as a chip on each of its conversations.
- An edited file updates its own conversation instead of adding a second one. A file that disappears keeps its conversation, and a conversation you delete stays deleted, even if its file changes later.
- Files you already imported by hand from the same folder are taken over, not copied.
- Only .txt and .md files up to 2 MB are read. Hidden files, links and files kept online only (OneDrive) are skipped and listed, and one bad file never stops the rest.

## Fixed

- Fireflies no longer re-reads old meetings that never got a summary on every sync, which made each Fireflies sync take about five minutes. A meeting still without a summary three days on is left alone.
- A sync that ended while the database was busy no longer leaves a source stuck on "running" in the sync history; it now shows as failed, with the reason.
- Search results and AI answers given to connected assistants never show part of a saved password or access key. Before, a key that sat right next to the word you searched for could lose its start and come out partly unhidden.
- An assistant connected with a fixed port only sends its access code to that port when it is the one ChatsRecall is using right now. Otherwise it says the code was not sent; remove the fixed port so it follows ChatsRecall.
- An access code limited to some accounts no longer lists the other accounts' projects when it exports a project.
